# InsulationGo

> Online builders merchant specializing in thermal insulation products, fire-stopping materials, and structural void formers for residential and commercial construction.

InsulationGo is a UK-based online supplier offering competitive pricing on premium insulation brands including Kingspan, Celotex, Promat, and British Gypsum. The company serves builders, contractors, and DIY customers across London and the UK with a comprehensive range of insulation solutions.

## Key Topics

- Thermal insulation
- PIR insulation boards
- EPS polystyrene
- Insulated plasterboards
- Fire-stopping insulation
- Void formers
- Ground heave protection
- Kingspan
- Celotex

- British Gypsum

- Non-combustible boards
- Building materials
- Residential and commercial construction
